description: This file manages caching and retrieval of machine learning models from various providers, including in-memory and disk caches, with functions for fetching, updating, and initializing cache refreshes.

methods.name: writeModels
methods.description: Asynchronously writes model data to a JSON file cache for a specific router.

methods.name: readModels
methods.description: Asynchronously reads model data from a JSON file cache for a specific router.

methods.name: fetchModelsFromProvider
methods.description: Fetches models from various provider APIs based on options, handling different provider cases.

methods.name: getModels
methods.description: Retrieves models from cache or fetches from provider if not cached, with caching logic.

methods.name: refreshModels
methods.description: Force refreshes models from API, updating caches, and preventing concurrent refreshes.

methods.name: initializeModelCacheRefresh
methods.description: Starts background refresh of public provider caches after extension activation.

methods.name: flushModels
methods.description: Clears the memory cache for a provider, optionally refreshing from API.

methods.name: getModelsFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves models from memory or disk cache, validating disk data with schema.

methods.name: getCacheDirectoryPathSync
methods.description: Synchronously gets the cache directory path for disk cache access.
